quote: If heritable editing or costly somatic therapies become available privately, they could widen gaps between those who can afford them and those who cannot. Globally, the divide could be even sharper. Some participants may worry about genetic tourism, where Australians travel to countries with looser rules, or about a future in which genetic privilege compounds existing inequalities. These concerns suggest that even if the technology is safe, questions of fairness cannot be ignored.
